required_changes: Add the material customer-scope behavior to the candidate and affected alerts/credits concept wording. The first tagged-promotion and grouped create bodies omit customer_id; the current create-operation authority says omission creates an all-customer notification, and the assigned guide explicitly says the grouped alert applies automatically to all customers and all current and future promotions. Keep that configuration blast radius separate from custom-field filters, which narrow the commits or credits evaluated within the alert. Do not imply that one grouped configuration is customer-scoped merely because each emitted payload identifies a customer.

Reconcile the worked POST create bodies with the current create authority instead of presenting only their matching behavior. State that the examples omit uniqueness_key even though create prose says every threshold notification must have an organization-unique key while the OpenAPI required array omits it; preserve that unresolved narrative/schema requiredness boundary. Separately apply the API-wide Idempotency-Key authority to POST /v1/alerts/create: identical same-key parameters replay the original result, changed parameters conflict, retention is at least 24 hours, and a cached result can be HTTP 500, while the endpoint adds no safe another-key, expiry, concurrency, or ambiguous-failure recovery guarantee. Keep resource uniqueness and request-result replay distinct and do not characterize the guide bodies as complete copy-ready requests.

Refine the worked-number authority boundary without converting threshold 10000 into a money amount. The guide's create bodies omit credit_type_id; the current create source says credit-based notification types require it in narrative guidance while its payload required array omits it, and the property description says the currency defaults to USD. State those scoped authorities while preserving that the assigned guide does not define the example's pricing-unit selection, minor-unit scaling, access-type interpretation, rounding, or conversion, so 10000 still must not be rendered as a dollar amount by inference. Also make the POST /v1/customer-alerts/get freshness boundary explicit: API-wide same-key replay recovers the prior result and is not evidence of a fresh alert evaluation; endpoint-specific caching, another-key, expiry, concurrency, and recovery behavior remain undocumented.
